prerequisites: Knowledge of the basics of calculus and statistics (probability, random variables and random vectors).

learning_outcomes.text: Know how to use some mathematical tools developed for the analysis of deterministic and random signals.
Know how to apply these tools to the analysis of: 1) analog-digital and digital-analog conversion; 2) analog and digital modulations; 3) noise processes and their effects in communication systems.
Acquire the ability to understand the technical literature concerning signal processing and communication systems.
Learn to apply the acquired knowledge to the analysis of signals and communications systems.
Learn to critically analyze the obtained results, and to present them.
Develop the ability to illustrate the obtained results in an effective and concise way, to express the learned concepts in an appropriate language and to discuss the covered topics.
Learn various methodological tools which are useful to continue their studies and update their own knowledge in the fields of signal analysis and communication systems.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the world of signals and systems
Classification of signals and their properties
Further tools for the spectral analysis of signals

assessment_methods.method: Two exercises completed in the MATLAB environment

assessment_rules: The exam consists of a written test, followed by an oral test. The written test consists of 4 open questions, with a total duration of 160 minutes, and consultation of teaching material is not permitted. The achievement of a sufficient score in the written test is a necessary condition for the oral test. The final grade represents the aggregate of the grades assigned to the written exam, the oral exam, and two exercises completed in the MATLAB environment.
bibliography: M. Luise, G. M., G. Bacci (e con la collaborazione di P. Di Viesti), Teoria dei segnali. Analogici, digitali, multimediali e dati, Quarta Edizione, McGraw-Hill Italia, 2026.

S. Haykin e M. Moher, Introduzione alle Telecomunicazioni Analogiche e Digitali, Casa Editrice Ambrosiana, 2007 (S. Haykin and M. Moher, Introduction to Analog & Digital. Communications, 2nd ed., Wiley, 2007).
All the lecture slides and MATLAB code are provided to students.
institution: Università degli Studi di Modena e Reggio Emilia
